podcast.body: Recorded partly before the band's trip to the Congo, this album was named after Chuck, a UN official who saved the band from an African civil war. The recording took place in a bunker-like studio located across the street from the Hells Angels headquarters in Toronto. The album was noted for its heavy yet melodic sound, likely influenced by the traumatic experience in Congo. "So we get to the Chuck record, which before you get there, you end up in the Congo."
